about: The 15-task rubric, Sova side: each task is stated once; a builder starting it gets the tools output for its seeds. Each of a-d is scored 0, 1 or 2 by a reader, blind to the arm where possible (sum /8 per task, /120 in total).
source: spec-slice task study, 2026-10-05, master at a95768b7: packet prose pages (up to 4 of 12,000 B per seed, following next) plus frontier, code, findings and impact, scored by hand

rubric.a: The promises the edit must keep are present.
rubric.b: The exact names, states, shapes and messages are present.
rubric.c: The neighbouring promises it could break are present.
rubric.d: The boundary: what the edit may ignore is named but not loaded.

tasks.task: Add one more condition under which the composer refuses Send, shown as a one-line reason on the composer; keep the draft.
A message sent while a turn is running waits under the turn. Let the user edit a waiting message in place (today they can only remove it).
Show the thinking level beside the model on the composer, changeable mid-session; hide it when the model has no levels.
The message/event that records a mid-session model change must also carry the model it replaced.
Add a setting that chooses which model (and level) new sessions start on.
Add a Rename action for a session in the sessions list.
Collapse long tool-call output in the transcript behind a 'show more' control.
Let the user fork a session from an earlier reply (not just the latest point).
Add a durable 'pinned' flag to the stored session record so it survives restart; old records without it must still load.
Allow two credentials/logins for the same provider and let the user choose which one new sessions use.
Let the owner revoke a public share link; the address must stop serving at once.
Add an address that opens a given session with the model picker already open (shareable, survives reload, Back closes it).
Add a Stop action on a row of the workers list (the list of things doing work on the user's behalf).
Every error the user sees in the chat must say what to do next. Apply the rule across the chat area.
Bug report against the composer source file: Enter sends twice when pressed during IME composition. Start from the file, find what it must keep.
